$comment: ghThrottleSlotWait is the tool layer of that cascade (standard → platform → this file → env). callerWaitMs maps a caller regex to its BACKGROUND slot wait in ms (integer 0..120000; invalid values are ignored and the standard backgroundWaitMs of 8000 applies). The caller stays in the background class. Operator 2026-10-20: parked-pr-conflict-watch waits up to 120 s for a slot. 2026-11-12: health-watch (hosts the pr-stall-sweep PR-list read) and advisory-label-sweep (red-team withheld publish) wait up to 60 s, under the 90 s maxHold. ghThrottle.cap resolves code default 6 → this file → WE_GH_THROTTLE_CAP (integer 1..50; invalid values warn and fall back). Evidence 2026-11-16 Mac Studio: shared 6 slots, calls ~0.9 s but slot waits 39-89 s, planner passes 6 s → 89 s with idle CPU; GraphQL points 228/10000; GitHub secondary limit 100 concurrent. cap = 12; revert = 6. ghThrottle.installationCap gives each known installation its own concurrency cap (standard 12 → platform → this file → WE_GH_THROTTLE_INSTALLATION_CAP, integer 1..50; invalid values fall back). ghThrottle.sharedFallbackCap bounds unknown or ambiguous calls to min(cap, sharedFallbackCap), standard 6 → platform → this file → WE_GH_THROTTLE_SHARED_FALLBACK_CAP (integer 1..50; invalid values fall back). R1009 accepts overlap with a full installation and imposes no aggregate installation ceiling.
